        loss_without = call['loss_without_call']
        loss_with = call['loss_with_call']

        # inclusive threshold: accepted if parseable and normalized >= threshold

        diagnostics.append({
            "accepted": accepted,
            "call_id": call_id,
            "normalized_gain": normalized

        if accepted:
            accepted_ids.append(call_id)
    result = {
        "accepted_call_ids": accepted_ids,
        "diagnostics": diagnostics
    }
